verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Segment Engage builds Audiences from tracking events, traits and computed traits, and the pricing page vaguely claims "AI‑powered audiences." Nothing in the pack documents describing an audience in natural language, having AI generate a segment definition for review, or grounding that generation in the workspace schema. The "AI-powered audiences" tagline is an adjacent marketing claim that does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
